A real lazy-load address wins over an inline data src when the payload is not kept

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions, InlineDataMedia

def main() -> None:
    html = '<p><img src="data:image/png;base64,AAAA" data-src="https://example.com/real.png" alt="icon"></p>'
    options = ConversionOptions(inline_data_media=InlineDataMedia("DropElement"))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
